channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield rises to highest since 2007 as Fed rate-hike expectations rise
item.description: The sell-off in U.S. government debt is deepening as investors increasingly price in an interest rate hike this week.

item.title: Iranian foreign minister will head to China for talks, as Pentagon reveals financial cost of war
item.description: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araqchi will visit China on Wednesday for talks, Beijing's foreign ministry announced on Tuesday.

item.title: Kraft Heinz bets on more flavors for Philadelphia cream cheese as it looks to revive brands
item.description: Philadelphia will release more cream cheese flavors as part of Kraft Heinz's turnaround.

item.title: Children's clothing retailer Carter's is rebranding to appeal to a new generation of parents
item.description: Children's clothing brand Carter's is announcing a rebrand as it tries to keep up with the modern parent and its core customer base.

item.title: Alphabet has been in a correction since May. Katie Stockton sees the Google parent breaking out
item.description: The founder of Fairlead Strategies breaks down where she sees the tech giant.

item.title: U.S. auto market predictions for 2030: More hybrids, no Chinese entrants
item.description: Despite growing speculation that it won't be long until Chinese autos are sold in the U.S., John Murphy doesn't expect that to happen by 2030.

item.title: Warsh's credibility is on the line this week as Trump policies put pressure on Fed to hike
item.description: With inflation above target and no visibility on lower oil prices or stability of tariffs, the Fed chairman needs to pass the test that has faced his predecessors

item.title: Oil’s next test: Saudi Arabia races to restore a key safety valve for prices
item.description: Analysts warn oil prices could rally sharply if the pipeline remains offline beyond an estimated five-to-seven-day inventory cushion.

item.title: What to watch as Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent testifies before Congress
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent may face questions on rising energy prices, Federal Reserve policy, government debt and the Trump team's economic agenda.

item.title: Wall Street weighs prospect of an AI slowdown on data center buildout
item.description: Investors see a potential AI slowdown as problematic for companies tied to the data center buildout.

item.title: Mitch McConnell returns to Senate after three-month health absence
item.description: The 84-year-old Kentucky Republican is back in Washington after a fall, hospitalization, pneumonia and weeks of rehabilitation kept him away from the Senate.

item.title: The Fed is likely to raise interest rates as inflation persists. What that means for consumers
item.description: The Federal Reserve is widely expected to raise its benchmark interest rate by a quarter percentage point at its September meeting.

item.title: U.S. seeks to seize $61 million of crypto it claims are proceeds from Iranian petroleum sales to Chinese buyers
item.description: Two Chinese companies, are alleged to have used trading accounts in Binance to launder the illicit proceeds and funnel the funds to Tehran or its proxies.

item.title: Counting the votes: Warsh faces a tough battle as the Fed girds for expected interest rate hike
item.description: Traders were pricing in a better than 92% probability of a rate increase, as well as a more than 75% chance for another one in December.

item.title: Trump goes scorched earth on AI warnings, raging about data center opposition and regulation
item.description: The Trump administration has encouraged AI's rapid growth and the development of data centers as it seeks an insurmountable tech edge over China.

item.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump bid to lift block on U.S. Postal Service mail-in ballots rule
item.description: Justice Brett Kavanaugh said that applying the U.S. Postal Service rule in the 2026 midterm elections "would be arbitrary and capricious."

item.title: The 10-year Treasury yield just hit 5%. How income investors can profit
item.description: Experts expect the volatility to continue. Here's where they see the best income opportunities.

item.title: Warren to rip Clarity Act on Senate floor ahead of key preliminary vote
item.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren will call the latest Clarity Act ethics proposal blessed by Trump a "weak fig leaf."

item.title: Samsung backs Nvidia AI chip rival in $230 million funding round as GPU alternatives boom
item.description: Dutch startup Euclyd raised the funding in a round co-led by Samsung, Somerset Capital Partners, the Scaleup Europe Fund and Innovation Industries.

item.title: Not all tech is under fire in Monday's selling, while investors seek refuge in defensive stocks
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Oil extends gains, Brent crude nears $108 following Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia
item.description: Oil extended gains amid reports of fresh Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia and attacks by Iran on ships in the Gulf.

item.title: CNBC Points Pro: How to avoid racking up credit card debt
item.description: Points expert Jason Stauffer shares strategies for avoiding spending money you don't have.

item.title: Broadcom CEO addresses Anthropic's slowdown push, says AI revenue targets haven't changed
item.description: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said demand for AI infrastructure remains strong despite growing concerns about increasingly powerful models.

item.title: Bank of America expects third-quarter investment banking fees to fall more than 10%; shares slide
item.description: The muted outlook from the country's second-largest bank by assets could be an early signal that Wall Street's AI boom might have hit turbulence.

item.title: Treasury hits Russia's VTB Bank with new sanctions over Iran ties
item.description: The new Russian bank sanctions follow a small handful of other actions that the Trump administration has taken since vowing to inflict "economic D-Day" on Iran.

item.title: Apple releases test of redesigned Siri AI before iPhone 18 hits stores this week
item.description: Following Apple's iPhone launch event last week, the company is releasing a redesigned Siri AI, though users may have to sign up for a waitlist.

item.title: Trump administration repeals Biden era greenhouse gas requirements for power plants
item.description: President Donald Trump has systemically dismantled regulations implemented by the Obama and Biden administrations that sought to fight climate change.

item.title: Trump-linked super PAC reports roughly $21 million in spending across key midterm races
item.description: President Donald Trump's political wartiest has spent much of the 2026 midterm election campaign cycle on the sidelines despite pleas from Republicans.

item.title: Trump phones Nvidia’s Huang at All-In Summit, calls data center opposition a ‘hoax’
item.description: President Trump has been using his social media site to sound off on Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's suggestion that the AI industry slow its pace of development.

item.title: The stock market could do something strange this week after the Fed decision
item.description: Odds of more interest rate hikes coming this year have grown.
